query: Are Mauritz Stiller and Johannes Grenzfurthner both of the same nationality?

pipeline_result.response: No, Mauritz Stiller and Johannes Grenzfurthner are not both of the same nationality. Mauritz Stiller was Finnish-Swedish, while Johannes Grenzfurthner is Austrian.
retrieved_context: Johannes Grenzfurthner: Johannes Grenzfurthner (] ; born 1975 in Vienna) is an award-winning Austrian artist, filmmaker, writer, actor, curator, theatre director and lecturer.  He is known as the founder, conceptualist and artistic director of monochrom, an international art and theory group.  Most of his artworks are labelled "monochrom".
Mauritz Stiller: Mauritz Stiller (17 July 1883 – 18 November 1928) was a Finnish-Swedish film director, best known for discovering Greta Garbo and bringing her to America.
